name: Honasa Consumer (Mamaearth)

figures.source: Screener.in (consolidated P&L) — annual Sales line; organised sector
india.json shares — share of summed revenue for the 3 listed IN brand owners (base INR 82,038cr). NOT a market share

read: The only listed pure-play BPC brand owner in India and therefore the cleanest read available on what a digital-native brand actually earns here: Rs2,392cr FY26 at a 10% operating margin. The margin path is the story — -290% FY21, 1% FY22, 2% FY23, 7% FY24, then back down to 3% in FY25 during the 'Project Neev' distribution reset (PAT Rs73cr, -32%) before recovering to 10% in FY26. An entrant should read that sequence as the real cost curve of building an Indian D2C brand to scale: five years to reach double-digit margin, with a reversal in the middle when the channel mix had to be rebuilt. It is also the benchmark that makes HUL's 8.5x revenue multiple for Minimalist legible — buyers are paying for growth that takes this long to earn organically.
